backend/main.mo: Motoko actor handling event submission, Callaway calculations, and storing latest results with sorting and chart-based deductions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to related files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file summarizing various frontend source files and their roles in the app.
frontend/docs/callaway-chart-defaults.md: Developer guide explaining how default Callaway chart values are defined and loaded.
frontend/DRAFT_RESTORED.md: Notes documenting restoration of a draft session without introducing functional changes.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS variables and theme definitions for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app with routing, scoring flow state, Callaway calculation, and layout structure.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying attribution, external link, and copyright.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header with title, start-over button, and navigation to settings and admin screens.
frontend/src/features/admin/AdminView.ts: Displays the admin panel or an access-disabled warning, providing navigation and showing chart editing notes when access is enabled.
frontend/src/features/admin/CallawayChar: Provides UI for editing 9- and 18-hole Callaway grid charts with validation, adjustments, and save/reset actions.
frontend/src/features/eventSetup/EventSe: Form for configuring event details such as title, course, golfer count, hole count, and par, with basic validation.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Breakd: Shows a detailed per-player Callaway scoring breakdown including gross, deductions, adjustment, and final net score.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Callaw: Displays the Callaway scoring chart for 9 or 18 holes along with a brief explanation of how scoring works.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/export: Generates a print-optimized HTML view in a new window to export tournament standings as a PDF.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Leader: Renders a ranked leaderboard table, assigning ranks with ties and displaying net, gross, deduction, and adjustment values.
Renders the leaderboard view with sorted results, a standings table, PDF export, and detailed breakdown panels.
frontend/src/features/scoreEntry/GolferS: Displays editable golfer entries, allowing name and hole score updates while computing gross totals.
frontend/src/features/scoreEntry/validat: Validates golfer data, ensuring names exist and hole scores are complete, valid, and within bounds.
frontend/src/features/settings/SettingsV: Shows the settings screen, allowing toggling of admin access and navigation back.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the current identity, invalidating dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAccessEnabled: Provides reactive admin-access state by listening to localStorage and custom events.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, handling login, logout, identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains React Query hooks, including fetching the latest result using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind layers, fonts, and light/dark OKLCH color variables for the UI theme.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/callaway.ts: Computes Callaway handicap results using persisted chart data, worst-hole deductions, and special gross<=par handling.
Provides Callaway chart entry types, legacy 9/18‑hole chart constants, and a helper to find the matching chart row for a gross score.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/callawayChartP: Implements localStorage loading/saving/reset of editable Callaway charts and exposes default 9‑hole and 18‑hole grid chart data.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps React app with QueryClient and Internet Identity provider and loads global styles.
frontend/src/state/adminAccess.ts: Handles localStorage-backed admin-access flag and emits change events when updated.
frontend/src/state/eventTypes.ts: Defines TypeScript data structures for event setup, golfer input, and Callaway result payloads.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with theme extensions, OKLCH color tokens, fonts, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Describes project state, issues, and existing features including routing fixes and Callaway chart correction.
